data.name: Durgaasri
data.long_meaning: The name Durgaasri signifies the grace or blessings of the goddess Durga. In Hindu mythology, Durga is the mother goddess and the embodiment of power, strength, and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'durga' meaning fort or invincible and 'asri' meaning grace or blessings.
